changeSummary: Zero Trust runtime decision prompt in the v20 dictionary format (W3-1 to W3-19, TO-1 to TO-5, LU-1 to LU-4, R4-T, R4-B9 and the P3 extra work; the 2026.10.14-v20.14 manifest lists them), with the P4 system text: the minimum action rules the host turned on, each naming its floor, P1 and P2 a challenge and P3 a review because a verified user does not supply a missing record (W4-4, N-P3-1); the boundaries and evidence rules on prompt facts only, the BLOCK boundary naming what is observed and a repeat, a new target or a large volume no risk by itself (N-RULE-1, N-WORD-1, N-FRIC-1); the output contract v3 block with the meaning and the cited line of every reason code, MATERIAL_MISSING_EVIDENCE citing the ID the UNKNOWN line gives each missing fact (W4-2, N-UID-1); no fixed reason sentences (W4-3). The response checker falls back to the contract's action after a failed retry (N-OUT-1, W4-5) and checks boundaries, reason claims and reason codes on the prompt's facts (W4-8). The golden render draws the baseline the sealed prompts state (N-GOLD-1). An approval or ticket without a decision time says what was not checked and does not prevent covered work (N-WORD-1, N-WORD-2). The business label is untrusted text (N-INJ-3); the usual rate counts the hour up to a request (N-RATE-1). Every Ticket value fits its form (N-DIC-2); the usual rate needs 60 counts and an assigned limit explains a size within it (N-FRIC-2). P5 drew the learning and memory facts anew: the non-allowed records (W5-4), one protection of what is learned (W5-9), and baseline statistics v2: counts, days and first and last times per dimension, one denominator, maturity by dates and convergence, one request rate, the organization usual by frequency, the peer comparison with the group size and the tenant in the baseline key (W5-10); the bundle declares its vocabulary (W5-7). Logins of two methods are kept and one holding a usual login is no departure (W5-10 D6); P3 takes only a floor the facts can meet (N-CONF-1).
